interpretation: Descriptive snapshot; no significance tests or new uncertainty claims.
Heldout accuracy counts absent/invalid answers as incorrect. ECE uses available selected-answer confidences only; Brier requires full distributions. Confidence and probability coverage are explicit.
T1 reference uses its restricted cohort, not all388 or all114. Old shortlist adapters are separate from actual LangGraph studies.
Attempt coverage includes unsupported/model-error outcomes and does not imply valid responses or success.
training_notes: Pretrained model weights remained frozen during this benchmark.
Linear classifier baselines were fitted using benchmark training examples; kNN used labeled training examples.
